cogadapt.title: CogAdapt: Adapting Clinical ECG Foundation Models for Wearable Cognitive Load Assessment | Mohammad Sadegh Sirjani
cogadapt.description: CogAdapt adapts clinical ECG foundation models to 3-lead wearable cognitive load assessment with LeadBridge and ProFine. IEEE EMBS BHI 2026.

rigeo.title: Optimizing Task Scheduling in Fog Computing with Deadline Awareness | Mohammad Sadegh Sirjani
rigeo.description: RIGEO combines Improved Golden Eagle Optimization with reinforcement learning for deadline-aware task scheduling in fog computing. IEEE SATC 2026.

contamination.title: Are LLM Benchmarks Already Contaminated? A Systematic Review of Contamination Detection Methods | Mohammad Sadegh Sirjani
contamination.description: A systematic review of 55 studies on LLM benchmark contamination: a four-tier taxonomy, five detection families, and a transparency card. GEM 2026 Outstanding Paper.

qteiot.title: QTE-IoT: Q-Learning-Based Task Scheduling Scheme to Enhance Energy Consumption and QoS in IoT Environments | Mohammad Sadegh Sirjani
qteiot.description: QTE-IoT classifies IoT tasks with an MLP and schedules them across fog and cloud with Q-learning hybrids QAVA and QARO. Sustainable Computing, 2025.

controllerPlacement.title: Controller Placement in Software-Defined Networks Using Reinforcement Learning and Metaheuristics | Mohammad Sadegh Sirjani
controllerPlacement.description: Bedbug-GLA places SDN controllers with cellular learning automata and an improved Bedbug metaheuristic, cutting energy and controller load. Cluster Computing, 2025.

clv.title: Data Mining and Cloud Computing for Customer Pattern Analysis and Value Maximization | Mohammad Sadegh Sirjani
clv.description: Data mining and cloud computing for customer churn prediction and lifetime value maximization. IEEE QICAR 2024.

secvanet.title: SecVanet: Provably Secure Authentication Protocol for Sending Emergency Events in VANET | Mohammad Sadegh Sirjani
secvanet.description: SecVanet is a provably secure authentication protocol for sending emergency events in VANETs, verified with Scyther. IEEE IKT 2023.

iotids.title: A Comparative Evaluation of Machine Learning Algorithms for IDS in IoT Network | Mohammad Sadegh Sirjani
iotids.description: A comparative evaluation of five machine learning classifiers for intrusion detection in IoT networks on UNSW-NB15. IEEE IKT 2023.
